The '''Resistance transport pod''' was a customized model of two-person light [[shuttle]] constructed from the [[cockpit]] of a [[B-wing Mark II]] by the [[Resistance]]. The pods were originally constructed to be grafted to passenger modules and used as [[Resistance transport|troop transports]] by the Resistance, but with their [[hyperdrive]] they could be separated and used on their own. During the [[Battle of Oetchi]] by the [[First Order]] in [[34 ABY]], the Resistance agents [[Rose Tico]] and [[Finn]] used a [[transport]] pod to [[Mission to Canto Bight|travel]] to the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]], where it was then destroyed by the [[Canto Bight Police Department]].

==Description==
[[File:Resistance_transport_pod_rear.png|thumb|left|250px|The engine of the Resistance transport pod was located at the rear.]]
The Resistance transport pod was a type of customized light [[shuttle]] created by the [[Engineer|technicians]] of the [[Resistance]] for use as an unarmed, two-person [[transport]]. The [[Starship|shuttle]] was originally constructed from the [[cockpit]] of [[Slayn & Korpil]]'s [[B-wing Mark II]] [[starfighter]], which the Resistance grafted onto a civilian passenger module in order to create the [[Resistance transport]]. When the cockpit was split back off from the module, it retained a [[hyperdrive]] to act as a standalone two person shuttle, needing one [[pilot]] and having room for one passenger. As a separate ship, the pod stood 5.72 [[meter]]s tall, 5.29 meters wide and 7.73 meters long.<ref name="TLJICS" />

The pod consisted of the cockpit, with its [[viewport]] on the left hand side, a [[sensor]] on the front and a stabilizer fin on top for [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] flight. The back of the pod housed the [[engine]], including [[thrust vectral]]s to direct [[plasma]] flow, while the left hand side of the pod bore a door that doubled as both the pilot's escape route and the port docking hatch. The attachment point for the transport's passenger module remained on the right hand side.<ref name="TLJICS" /> The pod's cockpit was [[armor]]ed with [[durasteel]].<ref name="TLJVD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

[[File:Cantonica.png|thumb|right|200px|Finn and Rose Tico flew a transport pod to Cantonica.]]

==History==
In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> the Resistance agents [[Rose Tico]] and [[Finn]] piloted a Resistance transport pod from the<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] to the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> during the [[Battle of Oetchi]] in search of the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were able to escape detection by the [[First Order]] [[First Order Navy|fleet]] attacking the Resistance due to the ship's small size and Tico's skill at keeping the pod's engine flux below sensor thresholds.<ref name="TLJVD" /> The pair crashed the pod on a beach outside the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]], where it was later destroyed by the [[Canto Bight Police Department]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Resistance transport pod first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> The ship was not named in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received identification in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
